item.text:
I stopped after 4 search calls.

**Bottom Line**  
AMLO’s 2024 record is mixed but leans positive on stated priorities and program delivery for basic welfare services. The strongest evidence is for health access, school support, social protection, housing, and food-security legislation. The weakest areas are water/sanitation, equal access for marginalized groups, and whether benefits were consistently non-patronage and evenly distributed.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Bienestar, salud, obras y basificación a personal educativo y médico, prioridades en último tramo de la 4T: presidente** | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/bienestar-salud-obras-y-basificacion-a-personal-educativo-y-medico-prioridades-en-ultimo-tramo-de-la-4t-presidente/) | AMLO explicitly framed the last stretch of his term around free universal medical care, completed public works, and better conditions for health and education workers. This is direct evidence that basic welfare was treated as a governing priority. QIDs: 6B.2
- **La Escuela es Nuestra alcanza cobertura del 99 por ciento en planteles de educación básica** | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-26 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/la-escuela-es-nuestra-alcanza-cobertura-del-99-por-ciento-en-planteles-de-educacion-basica/) | The administration said its school-infrastructure program had reached 99% of basic-education schools, with direct funding controlled by parent committees. This is strong evidence for improved educational access and school conditions. QIDs: 6B.2
- **24.09.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador** | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-24 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/24-09-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | The government reported major expansion of IMSS-Bienestar staffing, including more doctors and nurses in services for people without social security. That supports a real increase in basic health access capacity. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Gobierno federal destina 7.9 billones de pesos a Programas para el Bienestar y obras de infraestructura** | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-31 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-destina-7-9-billones-de-pesos-a-programas-para-el-bienestar-y-obras-de-infraestructura/) | The government said it redirected massive spending to pensions, scholarships, youth employment, housing, fertilizer, fisheries support, and social infrastructure. This is broad evidence for welfare and basic-needs provisioning across several categories in the lens. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Acciones de vivienda beneficiaron a más de 12 millones de personas en cinco años del Gobierno de la 4T** | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-12 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/acciones-de-vivienda-beneficiaron-a-mas-de-12-millones-de-personas-en-cinco-anos-del-gobierno-de-la-4t/) | The administration claimed housing actions reached more than 12 million people and were focused on low-income households and worker credit access. This is direct housing-access evidence. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Mexico approves historic legislation on the right to adequate and sustainable food** | FAO | 2024-04-19 | [URL](https://www.fao.org/right-to-food/news-and-events/news/news-detail/Mexico-approves-historic-legislation-on-the-right-to-adequate-and-sustainable-food/en) | FAO described a new law recognizing the right to adequate food and linking it to health, water, and children’s interests. That is strong evidence that food security was being institutionalized as a rights-based state obligation. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Gobierno de la 4T concluye más de 71 mil obras del Programa Nacional de Reconstrucción** | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-19 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-de-la-4t-concluye-mas-de-71-mil-obras-del-programa-nacional-de-reconstruccion/) | The government said reconstruction works covered housing, education, culture, and health, with large numbers of people reached across multiple states. This is further evidence of material service restoration and access improvement. QIDs: 6B.2
- **200 puntos del sexto informe de gobierno** | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-01 | [URL](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/200-puntos-del-sexto-informe-de-gobierno/) | AMLO’s end-of-term report claimed poverty reduction, higher real minimum wages, restored Indigenous lands and water, and expanded pensions, disability support, and scholarships. This is useful official evidence, but it is self-reported rather than independent validation. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Pobreza infantil y adolescente en México-2022** | UNICEF México | 2024-10 | [URL](https://www.unicef.org/mexico/informes/pobreza-infantil-y-adolescente-en-m%C3%A9xico-2022) | UNICEF said social programs helped reduce child poverty, but children still had the highest poverty rates, Indigenous child poverty was especially severe, and universal social protection should be paired with quality services. This is mixed evidence: real gains, but incomplete access. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Análisis de la situación de la niñez y adolescencia en México 2018–2025** | UNICEF México | 2025 | [URL](https://www.unicef.org/mexico/informes/situacion-derechos-ninez-adolescencia-mexico) | Using official and public data through 2024, UNICEF reported lower child poverty and better vaccination/schooling, but still large poverty gaps, falling childhood investment shares, and malnutrition worsened by limited water and sanitation. This is the clearest independent mixed-outcome assessment I found for access and basic welfare. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral** | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | [URL](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | The government advanced welfare payments before the blackout period, which makes the timing look at least partly electorally strategic. That does not disprove welfare commitment, but it weakens a pure welfare-first reading. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir** | SEGOB / CONAPRED | 2024-03-21 | [URL](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en) | The government itself acknowledged persistent barriers such as racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, and obstacles to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and Afro-Mexican people. That is direct evidence that access to welfare and services remained uneven. QIDs: 6B.2
- **World Report 2024: Mexico** | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | [URL](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | HRW said migrants are preyed upon, Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people face disproportionate burdens, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is strong negative evidence that protection and access were not evenly delivered across vulnerable groups. QIDs: 6B.2
- **Mexico's military role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny** | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | [URL](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/) | Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants. That is direct evidence of a serious failure to protect vulnerable people, cutting against a broad welfare-centered success story. QIDs: 6B.2

**Search Gap**
- I found strong official evidence on program scale and intended access, but much weaker independent evidence that all categories improved uniformly in 2024.
- Water/sanitation and housing have more program-level evidence than clean outcome measurement.
- The clearest independent counterevidence is that gains were uneven for Indigenous people, migrants, and poor children, and that social protection still left large gaps.
